title: GameCheckpointPane
responsibility: Describe and edit one checkpoint in a shared modal, with image approval and advanced executable rules.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.context
inputs.type: { checkpoint: Checkpoint; view: GameView; document: GameDocument; projectId?: string | null; revision?: string; commit?: string; bridge?: DesktopBridge; }
inputs.description: Selected checkpoint, view, document, project identity, revision and host bridge used by both editors.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.readonly
inputs.description: Disable editing and generation for historical or otherwise immutable views.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.change
inputs.description: Callback publishing the edited checkpoint, view patch or graph node list to its owner.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.adding
inputs.description: Present the new-checkpoint title and focus its description.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.close
inputs.description: Close the modal while preserving intentional edits and discarding untouched additions.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.remove
inputs.description: Delete the selected checkpoint through its document owner.

outputs.name: GameCheckpointPane
outputs.description: Describe and edit one checkpoint in a shared modal, with image approval and advanced executable rules.
